notes: Tail case: all units rewritten. U1 window identified by row/ordinal and changed to a glass tint; U2 coarse bicycle mask tightened with SAM3 and replaced by a scooter; U3 mask extended from the blue panel only to the whole freestanding sign (panel, frame, posts) so removal is physically coherent.

spec.ref: the second window from the image-left edge in the top row of the brick building

units.ref_zh: 砖楼最上面一排中从画面左边缘数第二扇窗户
units.instruction_ref_zh: 将砖楼最上面一排中从画面左边缘数第二扇窗户染成深蓝色调。
units.instruction_noref_zh: 将选中区域染成深蓝色调。
units.reason: Many identical windows; the masked one is the second from the left edge in the top row. Mask covers glass and frame, so a whole-window tint is used instead of an unclear 'colour of the window'.

spec.ref: the yellow bicycle at the right end of the bike racks next to the blue PSYCHOLOGY sign

units.ref_zh: 自行车架最右端、蓝色PSYCHOLOGY标牌旁的黄色自行车
units.instruction_ref_zh: 将自行车架最右端、蓝色PSYCHOLOGY标牌旁的黄色自行车替换为一辆红色电动滑板车。
units.instruction_noref_zh: 将选中区域替换为一辆红色电动滑板车。
units.reason: Red bicycle was a recolour; now a genuine category change. 2.5.0 mask was a coarse blob including rack and gravel; v2 is the SAM3 bicycle mask.

spec.ref: the blue directional sign on two brown posts at the left end of the bike racks

units.ref_zh: 自行车架左端立在两根棕色柱子上的蓝色指示牌
units.instruction_ref_zh: 移除自行车架左端立在两根棕色柱子上的蓝色指示牌。
units.reason: 'the sign at the lower left' was vague (the big PSYCHOLOGY sign is also low). Old mask was only the blue panel, leaving an empty frame and posts after removal; v2 covers the whole freestanding sign.
